## Select.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `options` :: The choices. Options sharing a `group` are listed together under that heading.
- `value` :: The chosen value — an array of values when `multiple` is set. Bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called with the new value whenever the person changes it.
- `multiple` :: Lets the person choose any number of options; `value` becomes an array and the list stays open.
- `placeholder` :: The text shown while nothing is chosen.
- `size` :: The control height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set. @default 'lg'
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the field. @default 'modern'
- `invalid` :: Marks the field as failing validation: a danger border and `aria-invalid`.
- `clearable` :: Shows a button that clears the value.
- `name` :: The name of the hidden input(s) that carry the value in a form submission.
- `open` :: Whether the list is showing. Bindable.
- `onOpenChange` :: Called when the list opens or closes.
- `disabled` :: Blocks opening the list and dims the field.
- `variant` :: The frame's visual style: `outline` draws the fill and border, while `ghost` and `secondary` drop the border.
- `surface` :: The recipe behind the drop-down: fill, border and shadow together. @default 'glass'
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the list's quieter text: group headings, descriptions and the empty row. @default 'text-xs'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the placeholder, the icons and the list's quieter text. @default 'text-muted'

### `function focusInitial`

Move focus into the list: the chosen option, else the first (or last) enabled one.

## options.ts

### `interface SelectOption`

One choice in a Select or Combobox. `T` is the type of the value it stands for.

- `value` :: The value written to `value` when the option is chosen.
- `label` :: The visible label; also what typeahead and filtering match against.
- `icon` :: An icon drawn before the label.
- `description` :: A second, quieter line under the label.
- `disabled` :: Shown but not choosable.
- `group` :: Options with the same group name are listed together under that heading.

### `function groupOptions`

Options in groups, keeping the order in which each group first appears. Ungrouped options form a group with no heading.

### `function valueKey`

A string for a value — the form value of a hidden input, and a stable DOM id fragment.
